conclusion: The defining article, relevant supplements, probe workbook, cited 10x Rev A/Rev B guides, current IDT guide, and DOGMA predecessor resolve the published probe inventory and inherited fixed 10x shells. Published probe specifications still disagree and are disclosed on the page. The exact ReDeeM junction model, historical IDT revision, and full cited mtscATAC predecessor review remain blocked; no claim of unpublished fixed oligos is accepted.
